lines.label: press_beat
lines.en: I'm not writing any of this down yet. That's a courtesy, and courtesies expire.

lines.label: press_beat
lines.en: Everyone in this building thinks you're the easy one. I'd like to keep disagreeing.

lines.label: press_beat
lines.en: Something goes out of their shoulders. Not fear — calculation, arriving late.

lines.label: press_beat
lines.en: There's a version of tonight where you walk out of here. I need something to trade for it.

lines.label: press_beat
lines.en: The room gets smaller. The door is still open, and it stays open unless you close it.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Close the door?

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Leave it open. I'd rather you lied to me with your clothes on.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Afterwards the room is exactly as loud as it was.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Afterwards the room is exactly as loud as it was.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: He does not perform. He negotiates, the way he does everything, and the negotiation is the part he cannot help enjoying.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: You understand this doesn't buy you the truth. It buys you my attention.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Attention's cheaper than a lawyer.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Everything is, until you need one.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: He is unhurried in a way that is meant to be read, and he lets it be read. Somewhere underneath, a man is doing arithmetic and not liking the total.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: You want to know why I'm still in this room. It isn't you.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: It's that I locked the office at two and the office was empty, and I have spent every hour since then being the only person that is inconvenient for.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Somebody was past the bar.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Somebody was past the bar. I heard the strip curtain. I did not look, because looking is how you end up on a list.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: He says it like a man setting a stone down. Then he is finished, and the finishing is as deliberate as the rest of it.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: She decides it, start to finish. You are the one being interviewed, and you both know it before the lamp is off.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: When you write this up, spell my name right.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: A-D-A-E-Z-E.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Good. People get one chance at that.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: There is nothing nervous in her. Whatever she is spending here she has already priced, and the price was never the point.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: My name is on the lease. Do you understand what that means at four in the morning with a dead man in my office?

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: It means it is mine. Whatever happened in my building, I own it before anyone hands it to me.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Then own this. What did you hear?

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: The pause is the only crack she lets you see.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: The cooler door. It has a seal, it drags. I heard it drag after I set the alarm, and I told myself it was the compressor, and I went home.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Write that down too. I'd rather you had it than kept it.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Vee shakes. Not because of you. Because of something that was in the room before you got here.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Don't stop asking. If you stop asking I'll start thinking.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: About what?

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: About how long a room takes to get warm again.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Whatever this is, it is not appetite. It is a person holding on to the nearest solid thing. You have decided to be the solid thing. You can decide later whether that was a kindness.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Everyone keeps saying eleven minutes. Off the van, on the floor, gone. I said it so many times it stopped being a sentence.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: How long were you really there?

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Long enough to stop feeling my hands.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Vee hears it land. Does not take it back. Does not look at you either.

lines.label: suspect_route
lines.en: Afterwards the room is exactly as loud as it was.

lines.label: out_of_questions
lines.en: That's your twelve, Reyes. Captain wants a name or wants them walking.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: He is slower than last time. Not softer — a man moving something heavy and not wanting it heard.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Second time in a month. You will forgive me for knowing where the chair is.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: You said to write down that you liked her.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: I said it first so you would not be able to put it anywhere clever later.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: For a while he is exactly as present as he intends to be. Then for a moment he is not, and he notices, which costs him more than it costs you.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: She asked me what it costs to leave a place like this. I gave her a number. I have been trying for three weeks to remember whether it was a kind number.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Was it?

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: It was accurate. I have only ever been good at accurate.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Then be accurate now. What was wrong out there?

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: The bay light. It is on a timer and it was off, and it does not fail. Somebody killed it from inside, and the switch for it is in the mop room.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: He gives you that, and then he is a closed office again. Lights off, everything filed.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: She closes the door herself this time. She does not ask, and she does not hurry, and somewhere in there is the answer to a question you have not asked yet.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Six years. I signed every page she wrote.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: You keep saying that like it's an alibi.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: It is the opposite of an alibi. Try to keep up.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: She is not performing grief and she is not hiding it. She is holding it the way you hold a glass you have decided not to set down.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Do you know what she did, the last time I saw her? She warned me. An auditor was coming and she told me first, because she thought that was decent.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: It was decent.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: It was the most frightening thing anyone has ever done to me.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: That is the closest she comes to giving you anything, and she gives it with her chin up, the way she does everything.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Where were you at half three?

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: The mop room. I will say it before you find someone who says it for me.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Write it down. All of it. Spell my name right.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Vee does not shake this time. Vee is very still, which you have learned is worse.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: You came and got me again.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: I came and asked.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: You came with two uniforms and asked.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: There is nothing to say to that, so you do not say it, and the not-saying is the first honest thing either of you has managed tonight.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: She wrote down every crate I ever brought through that door. Six years. She never once wrote down my name.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Why does that matter.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Because everybody else in my life keeps a list. Hers was the only one I wasn't on.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Whatever happens after that happens slowly, and none of it is about you, and you let it not be about you, which is the most you have to give.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: I came back for a jacket. Around four. There was a light on in the mop room.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Did you go in.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: No. I have been sick about it every day since.

lines.label: route_bay
lines.en: Vee says it to the ceiling. You write it down anyway.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: He is the one who closes the door. He has never done that before, and he lets you see that he has never done it before.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Third time, Reyes.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Third time.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: At some point a habit is a relationship. I am not sure which of us that should worry.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: He is unhurried, the way he has been every time. Tonight it reads differently: not a man taking his time, a man with nowhere left to be.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Marek. Iris. Now an inspector with a folder. You have sat across from me for all three and you have never once asked me for anything.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Should I have.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Everyone else in this building has. Adaeze asks. Vee asks with their whole body. I am the only one who never has, and you have found that restful.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: He waits for that to be worth something. It is.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Ask yourself why the patient one is patient. That is the whole case and I have just handed it to you for nothing.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: He straightens his cuff. He is, as ever, finished exactly when he intended to be.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: She is not in charge tonight and does not pretend to be, and the missing performance is more intimate than the performance ever was.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: I signed nothing this month.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: I noticed.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Somebody else can be on every page for a while. I have been on every page since I was twenty-three.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: She is tired in a way the hour does not explain, and for once she lets the room see it, and you are the room.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Do you know what I did last night? Sat upstairs with the lights off, doing nothing at all, which is the only thing left that nobody can countersign.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: You saw something.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: The office light. From the flat you can see it thrown on the yard wall. It was on at one. I watched it go out.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: And you didn't come down.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: I have come down twice. Both times there was a person on the floor and my name on the lease.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: She says it without excuse, which is not the same as without shame, and she knows you know the difference.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Vee came in alone. Walked the four blocks. Sat down before anyone asked, and that is the part you keep turning over afterwards.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: I'm here. Nobody had to come and get me.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: I know.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: That has to be worth something. Not to a judge. To you.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: It is worth something. There is no box on the form for it, so you put it where you put the rest of it.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: I was in the yard from midnight. You can hear the office through the vent. Not words. Just that there are words.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: And then?

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Feet on the stairs. Going down slow, like carrying.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Slow down, quick up?

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Slow down. Quick up. Nobody carries anything up.

lines.label: route_stairs
lines.en: Vee waits to be disbelieved. You do not, and it takes them a long moment to find anywhere to put that.
